items.label: Chat fade in Settings
items.discord_line: On the main launcher build, open Settings and find the chat fade control. If fade is off, turn it on. Send a few chat lines and wait. Pass when the text fades after a short time, or when you can clearly turn fade on and off (try Never and a timed option such as 5 or 15 seconds if those choices are there). If you cannot find chat fade, ask staff which Settings screen holds it on this main build.

items.label: Needs bars and the needs command
items.discord_line: On main, find the needs bars on the HUD. Hide them the way Settings allows, then bring them back. Type /needs in chat (or the needs command staff names if this build differs). Pass when the bars follow Settings and the command shows useful needs info instead of doing nothing. If bars or the command are missing, ask staff what main uses right now.

items.label: Discord connect before Play
items.discord_line: On the main launcher, try Play when Discord is not connected, or when your Discord account is not accepted yet (staff can hand you a test login if you need one). Pass when you get a clear apply message and a working control that opens the Discord invite, and you do not get into the game. With an accepted Discord account connected, Pass when Play starts the normal way on main. If stuck, ask staff for an unaccepted test login; do not invent accounts.

items.label: Craft the same thing twice after you respawn
items.discord_line: On main, respawn, then go to a forge. Bring enough materials for two of the same craft. Craft that recipe once, then craft it again. Pass when both finished items stay in your pack. Forges are on main live; do not Skip this row. If you cannot find a forge or materials, ask staff where to go and which simple recipe to use.

items.label: Starting gold is 40 once
items.discord_line: On a brand-new character on main, check your gold the first time you enter the world. Pass when starting gold is exactly 40. Quit to the main launcher, come back on the same character, and check again: you must not get another free 40. If your first entry shows a different amount, ask staff whether you used a leftover character before marking Fail.

items.label: Trade gold with someone else
items.discord_line: On main, with a second person online, open trade and move some of your pack gold to them (and back if you like). Pass when both packs update to match the trade, and any fee takes gold away instead of leaving totals wrong. Do not test buying from traders on this row. If you have no second person, ask staff to join you for the trade.

items.label: No free extra gold
items.discord_line: On main, try the usual ways people grab more free gold: a second starter purse, or a craft that should spend or ignore gold rather than hand you more. Pass when the game refuses with a clear error you can see, and your gold does not silently jump up. Ask staff which safe refuse case to try if you are unsure. Do not test trader shops here.

items.label: Quit and relaunch keeps your pack
items.discord_line: On main, note your inventory and gold, quit to the main launcher on purpose, then launch again on the same character. Pass when your pack and gold match what you had, with no extra starting gold added. If something is missing or gold went up, say what changed and ask staff before you guess.

items.label: Refused craft keeps your materials
items.discord_line: On main, try a craft the game should refuse (staff will name one if you need it). Pass when your materials stay in the pack and you see a clear reason it was refused. Do not mark Pass only because a recipe is hidden without a perk. If you cannot trigger a refuse, ask staff which case to use on main live.

items.label: K panel shows profession and half
items.discord_line: On main, open the K panel on a normal character made under the current rules. Pass when you can see both your profession and your half. If the panel is blank or wrong, ask staff which character to use before marking Fail on an old leftover.
